name: Pirates

specialRules.name: Swabbies
specialRules.text: Only humans can be recruited. Enemy human Heroes who are Captured after a game may be offered a place: both players roll 2D6 adding Leadership (Captain vs captured Hero); each side that won the game adds +1. If the Pirate wins, the Hero becomes a Crewman (equipment sold off, stats reset to starting Crewman, joins a Crew group of 4 or fewer or starts a new one); otherwise he becomes a Swabbie, keeping skills and characteristics but only using the Swabbie list. Enemy human Henchmen lost for good (1-2 post-game) are taken on a roll of 7+ on D12 (4+ on D6), only if the Pirates won, and test the same way. Stragglers: a Leadership test makes him a Swabbie. Prisoners: D3 rescued, separate Leadership test each to join as Crew (starting stats, 0 exp, player pays for equipment), else Swabbie. Hired Swords and Special Characters can never be recruited.

specialRules.name: Hired Swords and items
specialRules.text: Unless noted otherwise, same access to Hired Swords and items as a regular human Mercenary warband. +20 gc upkeep if both Dwarfs and Elves are in the warband.

specialRules.name: Starting Swabbies
specialRules.text: In a one-off game the warband starts with two Swabbies for free.

specialRules.name: Succession
specialRules.text: If the Captain is killed, a Mate takes over as a Champion would in a Mercenary warband.

specialRules.name: Pirate special skills
specialRules.text: Cutlass Master: with a Sword, may also parry on a roll equal to the to-hit roll, only when in cover or in a building or within 2" of a wall/tree etc. Booming Voice (Captain only): once per turn, one pirate within 8" who failed a test to flee combat or to stop fleeing may re-roll it; Captain must be standing and not in close combat. Hardy Constitution: ignores a Critical Hit on a roll of 9-12. Swashbuckler: Leadership test at end of any hand-to-hand phase when in base contact; if passed may move away (no run/charge) without being struck. Sea Shanty Singer: at start of his Close Combat phase one opponent in base contact must pass a Leadership test or lose 1 Attack that turn (not Undead or non-living creatures). Sea Legs: when he Falls, ignores the D3 hits on a roll of 7+ (single roll); if knocked down or stunned within 1" of a precipice may re-roll his Initiative test to see if he falls.

items.name: Compass
items.note: 45+2D6 gc, Rare 9. Re-roll deployment roll once

items.name: Hardtack Biscuits
items.note: Common. One per model, one use: +1 Toughness for the turn and enemy turn; roll afterwards, on 1-2 the pirate misses the next game

items.name: Hook Hand
items.note: Common. One per model; counts as a dagger in that hand, no two-handed weapons; ignores Hand Injury/Arm Wound on 7+

items.note: 40+2D6 gc, Rare 9. One per warband; Heroes only; pirates within 12" never All Alone; takes one hand

items.name: Parrot
items.note: Rare 8. Captain and Mates only; enemies in base contact -1 to hit in first round unless they pass a Leadership test

items.name: Peg Leg
items.note: Common. One per model; -1 Movement (and max); special save of natural 12 when failing any save, unmodified

items.name: Spy Glass
items.note: Rare 8. Detect one hidden enemy on 7+; cannot run or charge

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any pirate within 6" may use his Leadership for any Leadership test.

fighters.name: Gunner

specialRules.name: Swivel Guns is Dangerous, Matey!
specialRules.text: A Gunner with a Swivel Gun is always an individual model (new Gunner or split from a group, keeping experience and skills).

fighters.notes: Special equipment list not stated for Gunners; only the Gunner list is used.

fighters.name: Boatswain

specialRules.name: Expert Riggers
specialRules.text: May re-roll failed Initiative tests for Leaping over Gaps, Jumping Down, Diving Charge, and Climbing with a Rope.

fighters.notes: Rope & Hook can never be sold or given away.

fighters.name: Swabbie

specialRules.name: Not Hired
specialRules.text: Not hired; follow the special recruitment rules.

specialRules.name: Rabble
specialRules.text: Need not be armed alike; only Swabbie list items; can never use magic.

specialRules.name: Blimey, they got away!
specialRules.text: Swabbies who already left the table when the warband Routs escape and are removed from the roster. Swabbies running away or out of action do not count toward Rout tests.

fighters.notes: No hire cost (not hired). Never more Swabbies than Crew. Warband limit 5.

conversionNotes: Sea Legs 4+ -> 7+; Hardy Constitution 5+ -> 9+; Hardtack Biscuits tainted on roll of 1 -> 1-2; Peg Leg and Hook Hand 4+/6+ -> 7+/natural 12; Spy Glass 4+ -> 7+; Chain Shot knockdown 4+ -> 7+; Swabbie henchman recovery 4+ -> 7+ (6+ -> natural 12 per group ruling).
Toughened leathers: PDF says 6+ armour save like light armour; recorded as 'works like light armour'.

Price Chart special items (Compass, Hardtack, Hook Hand, Jolly Roger, Parrot, Peg Leg, Spy Glass, Treasure Map) put in a separate 'pirate-special' list attached to Captain/Mates/Cabin Boys/Crew/Boatswains; PDF says they are mainly after-game purchases, so whether they are available at warband creation is unclear. Swivel Gun, Belaying Pin, Boat Hook, Cat O' Nine Tails and Toughened leathers are in the starting lists.
Pistol and Dueling Pistol brace prices recorded in notes.
Swabbie cost 0 (not hired); count toward the 15 model limit. Treasure Map table and Mordheim background omitted.
Swivel Gun Ball Shot concussion (Injury rolls of 2-4 stunned) left unconverted; d12 injury table needs a human decision.
